claims.claim: R3 produces the recorded detections on the D1 held-out test split at the pinned thresholds.
claims.evidence: R3/CVR2-CV-006 records 18 images, 15 boxes, P/R/F1 at 0.100 and 0.250.
claims.limitation: Small test split; all positive support is road_waterlogging; D1 source claims remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Aggressive augmentation degraded results relative to conservative augmentation in the recorded R2 comparison.
claims.evidence: R2.1 audit records controlled config comparison; mAP50 0.9649 conservative vs 0.5714 strong.
claims.limitation: Small, provenance-uncertain D1 corpus; no broad generalization claim.

claims.claim: Hard negatives caused suppression of false positives.
claims.evidence: R2.1 found zero false positives at the evaluated 0.25 threshold for both arms; R3-008 calls causal suppression insufficiently evidenced.
claims.limitation: Threshold gating and small negative-scene samples do not isolate a hard-negative causal effect.

claims.claim: R3 generalizes across independent civic datasets.
claims.evidence: R4 did not admit D2 or run cross-dataset evaluation.
claims.limitation: No independent dataset or comparable evaluation exists.

claims.claim: R3 is robust to the tested controlled visual perturbations.
claims.evidence: R3 and R5 report fixed-threshold measurements on controlled conditions.
claims.limitation: Small repeated D1 source set, synthetic shifts, class support limitations; severe transformations produce errors.

claims.claim: R3 is temporally robust on real-world civic videos.
claims.evidence: R6 uses synthetic sequences from still images and explicitly reports real video unavailable.

claims.claim: Multimodal context improves assessment consistency or evidence quality.
claims.evidence: R7 and R9 contain zero eligible civic cases; R8 case dataset unavailable.
claims.limitation: No legitimate independent modalities linked to cases.

claims.claim: Authority evidence supports legal or maintenance responsibility attribution.
claims.evidence: R8/R9 contain no verified road, jurisdiction, authority, or project records.
claims.limitation: No legal responsibility assessment or statutory authority established.

claims.claim: The existing geographic slices establish geographic generalization.
claims.evidence: R3 slices are small and rely on D1 recorded geographic labels; R4 reports unresolved provenance.
claims.limitation: No independent verified geography or external domain test.

claims.claim: Synthetic R5 rain-like transforms demonstrate weather or rainfall evidence.
claims.evidence: R5 manifest and report describe procedural image overlays.
claims.limitation: No physical weather observation or causal data.

claims.claim: Research results establish broad real-world civic applicability.
claims.evidence: Only small internal CV test data and controlled synthetic variants were evaluated.
claims.limitation: No field evaluation, independent dataset, or civic-case outcome study.

claims.claim: CV confidence measures physical severity or verified truth.
claims.evidence: The research protocol explicitly separates confidence, severity, observation, and verification.
claims.limitation: No severity ground truth is available in this research record.
